claims.sentence: You must hold citizenship of a country outside the Commonwealth of Independent States to participate in the competition

You must be in the final year of secondary education, a graduate of secondary vocational education (for bachelor's programs), or a current student or graduate of higher education (for master's programs)
Your education documents must be legalized according to Russian law and translated into Russian unless an international treaty states otherwise
You cannot participate if you were or are a student in
The competition runs annually from 1 October of the year before admission to 10 August of the admission year
Grants cover tuition starting from the academic year following the competition
You may participate only once per year
Stage one requires you to register on the Official Website and pass an online test

You must submit a completed questionnaire, a motivation letter in English, a portfolio in English, copies of your education certificates or diplomas, an English proficiency certificate if available, and a signed consent to data processing
The passing score is 45% correct answers for the English test for bachelor's programs or 50% for master's programs, and 45% for the profile test
If you pass stage one, you will receive an invitation to your registered email
You must confirm participation within 7 calendar days of the email's sending date, or you will be withdrawn from the competition
Winners must sign an education contract by the admission order date, sign a grant contract by the start of the academic year, and attend the Summer School if organized
Your GPA from the previous semester must be below 4.33 for Russian students or below 4.37 for foreign students
Your per-capita family income must be below the regional minimum subsistence level for Russian students or the country's minimum subsistence level for foreign students
You can submit your application and documents any working day, including holidays
You must provide a family composition certificate and a parents' income certificate
Foreign students may submit documents in English or their home country's language, and you are responsible for translation even if the department assists
You may receive aid once or monthly until the next interim assessment
Payments occur on the nearest scholarship day if submitted at least one week prior, otherwise on the next month's scholarship day
The director or authorized person decides based on the scholarship commission's petition
You must attend at least 70% of classes to keep support, and failure stops payments
If your semester GPA does not improve, you will be denied aid the following semester
The commission decides on one-time aid based on your application and need documents

Full-time students receive a maternity benefit from federal budget funds for 70 days before birth, 84 days for multiples, 70 days after birth, 86 days for complicated births, or 100 days for two or more children
You must have no "satisfactory" grade at interim assessment and no academic debt to receive a state scholarship

Full-time students who are orphans, disabled, Chernobyl or radiation victims, military injury or veteran recipients, social aid recipients, or contract military personnel may receive a state social scholarship
This scholarship is awarded from document submission until the basis expires, or until studies end if the basis is lifelong, except for social aid recipients
First or second year students with excellent or good grades meeting the social categories, or students under 20 with one disabled parent, may receive an enhanced state social scholarship
This enhanced scholarship follows the same duration rules as the standard social scholarship
Students admitted from 2024 onward must have no "satisfactory" grade and no academic debt to receive university scholarships
You must have a signed grant contract providing for university scholarships to receive them
Bachelor's students with excellent grades for the last two periods and no academic debt may receive an enhanced university academic scholarship
The evidence cuts off the exclusion clause for grant competition participants
The evidence cuts off the full list of categories for state social scholarship eligibility
